reviews.review_title: Review at T.Plus BBQ World Restaurant
reviews.review_text:
Hans M
Lelystad, The Netherlands47 contributions
0
Best restaurant in town
Jan 2020
The Vietnamese don't have a lot of restaurants where both the food and the surroundings are nice, but this is one!
You can sit outside in a garden where you don't notice all the traffic outside and which looks nice and peaceful.

T.Plus is a Korean BBQ restaurant with superb food. The first night we had diner here, one of the staff members cooked all our food at our table (you are supposed to do that yourself, but we had never done it!). Second time was during New Year holiday season and food was still superb, but we had to cook it ourselves :).

T.Plus is a little more expensive than the average restaurant in Ho Chi Minh city, but worth every Dong.

Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. We wanted to change the one of the set menus a bit, which was no problem at all.

reviews.review_text:

Brilliant BBQ end to my two week trip.
Sep 2019
The great thing about this restaurant is the small portions--many dishes presented as a single skewer--which allows you to have an astonishing variety of food.

I came upon it by chance while looking for Barbecue Garden which seems to have disappeared into a building site!!

T Plus allowed me to have a long, leisurely lunch and to revisit the tastes and flavours of the previous fortnight.

Also a great range cocktails and mocktails [I would recommend the Immune System mocktail in particular]. 

I couldn't have wished for a better end to my holiday.
